what: BHP is the world's largest mining company by market value. It digs iron ore in Western Australia, copper in Chile and Australia, and steelmaking coal, and is building a potash mine in Canada.
customers: Steel mills and metal buyers, above all in China.
moat: Some of the lowest-cost, longest-life mines in the world.
risks: Chinese steel demand and iron-ore prices
opportunities: A dividend yield above 5% paid from low-cost iron ore cash flow
Copper production is rising, which diversifies it away from iron ore
Its Australian iron ore operations are among the lowest-cost in the world
watch: Iron ore shipment volumes and copper production growth.
